raw.description:
Als expandierendes Unternehmen der Chemiebranche entwickelt, produziert und vertreibt die HOTREGA GmbH seit 1997 innovative Reinigungs- und Pflegemittel sowie hochwertige Kleb- und Dichtstoffe - auch im hauseigenen Labor, Made in Germany.

Das bieten wir Ihnen:

  • Attraktive tarifliche Vergütung inklusive Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
  • Strukturierte und umfassende Einarbeitung
  • Individuelle Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte, Corporate Benefits und JobRad

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Betreuung der zugeordneten Produkt- und Warengruppen im operativen Einkauf
  • Einholung, Prüfung und Vergleich von Angeboten sowie Abstimmung von Preisen und Konditionen
  • Betreuung und Ausbau unserer nationalen und internationalen Lieferanten
  • Unterstützung bei der Beschaffung und Importabwicklung, insbesondere im Einkauf aus Asien
  • Durchführung von Markt-, Preis- und Wettbewerbsanalysen zur Unterstützung von Einkaufsentscheidungen
  • Teilnahme an Lieferantengesprächen und -besuchen sowie an relevanten Fachmessen
  • Enge Abstimmung mit internen Fachbereichen wie Produktmanagement, Vertrieb und Logistik

Das bringen Sie mit:

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung
  • Erste Berufserfahrung im Einkauf ist wünschenswert – auch engagierte Berufseinsteiger sind willkommen
  • Interesse an technischen Produkten, idealerweise aus dem Bereichen Werkstatt- und Industrieeinrichtung
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit internationaler Beschaffung oder Importen aus Asien sind von Vorteil
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die Kommunikation mit internationalen Lieferanten
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise

That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.</p> <p>Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. raw.title: Building Regulations & Permitting Specialist
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • You own Proxima Fusion's building regulations and permitting strategy - across multiple sites, from day one.

  • Your work spans the Alpha facility permitting process, site development approvals, and the early regulatory landscape definition for Stellaris - a programme horizon broad enough that you will be shaping permitting strategy for projects still being defined alongside those already in motion.

  • Permitting is a critical path item, not a support function. You ensure that regulatory requirements are understood early and fed upstream into design and planning decisions - and that Proxima Fusion's relationships with planning authorities are built on solid ground.

  • You work in close coordination with both the Head of Siting & Infrastructure, responsible for Proxima’s construction projects and the Head of Licensing & Regulation, who leads Proxima Fusion's nuclear and radiation licensing strategy - ensuring that building permit timelines and licensing requirements are sequenced correctly and never work against each other.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the permitting strategy and execution for Alpha across all relevant sites - defining the regulatory pathway, managing authority relationships, and ensuring permitting timelines are embedded as hard inputs into the Integrated Master Schedule

  • Lead building regulations and planning approval processes across Garching and Gundremmingen simultaneously; manage the possibility of a site change as a live planning scenario without losing momentum on either active front

  • Establish and maintain working relationships with relevant planning and building authorities, and specialist regulatory advisors at all locations

  • Ensure permitting requirements flow upstream into the Basis of Design and structural, systems, and MEP design inputs - not the other way around; act as the bridge between regulatory constraints and the engineering team

  • Prepare and manage permitting documentation in coordination with the lead architect and external planning team; own the submission process and track authority responses

  • Define the regulatory landscape and way-forward playbook for Stellaris permitting preparation - including site-specific constraints, authority mapping, and timeline implications - so that when Stellaris permitting begins in earnest, the groundwork is already in place

  • Coordinate closely with the Head of Licensing & Regulation to ensure building permit processes and nuclear licensing requirements are sequenced coherently - flagging where planning approvals and licensing timelines interact, and ensuring neither track creates blockers for the other

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced in building regulations, planning law, and permitting processes for major industrial, energy, or research infrastructure projects in Germany - you know how German planning authorities work and how to move them

  • Strategic as well as operational: you can define a multi-site permitting strategy and manage its execution simultaneously, not just process individual applications

  • Comfortable working in a design-inform role - you understand how regulatory constraints shape structural and systems design decisions, and you engage with engineers upstream rather than reviewing outputs downstream

  • Experienced managing authority relationships directly - you are the owner-side face to planning bodies, not a coordinator of external consultants who hold those relationships

  • Aware of the radiation protection licensing landscape in Germany - you do not need to be a specialist, but you understand how nuclear or radiation-related facility licensing timelines interact with building permit sequencing and can plan accordingly

  • Fluent in German and English, written and spoken - authority relationships are German-language; internal working language is English

  • Familiar with AI tools and digital working methods; comfortable in a lean, high-autonomy environment

  • Background in planning, building regulations, or regulatory affairs for energy, industrial, or research facilities is strongly preferred; experience across multiple simultaneous permitting processes is a strong plus

  • Aware of the radiation protection and nuclear licensing landscape in Germany is a plus - you do not need to be a specialist, but you understand how licensing timelines interact with building permit sequencing and can coordinate effectively with the Head of Licensing & Regulation who owns that domain

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • Final CEO call (30 min)

raw.title: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
raw.description:
We want you!

Du willst Recruiting nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten?
Wir wachsen weiter und suchen Verstärkung für unser Recruiting-Team.
Unser Ziel ist klar: Wir wollen unsere Zahl an Einstellungen deutlich steigern und dabei neue Wege gehen. Dafür suchen wir dich als Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Performance Recruiting.
Bei uns geht es nicht nur darum, eingehende Bewerbungen zu bearbeiten. Du sorgst aktiv dafür, dass die richtigen Menschen auf uns aufmerksam werden, sich bei uns bewerben und den Weg vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Einstellung erfolgreich durchlaufen.


Das erwartet Dich bei uns

Performance Recruiting & Candidate Experience

  • Du entwickelst und steuerst zielgruppenspezifische Recruiting-Kampagnen über Jobbörsen, Social Media und weitere digitale Kanäle
  • Du testest unterschiedliche Zielgruppen, Botschaften, Anzeigen und Kanäle und optimierst diese kontinuierlich
  • Du analysierst Bewerbungszahlen, Conversion Rates, Cost-per-Application und Cost-per-Hire und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab
  • Du entwickelst unsere Recruitingkanäle kontinuierlich weiter und identifizierst neue Möglichkeiten Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten zu erreichen
Recruiting
  • Du begleitest Bewerberinnen und Bewerber durch den gesamten Recruitingprozess
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Führungskräften und Fachbereichen zusammen
  • Du baust unseren Talent Pool auf und reaktivierst geeignete ehemalige Bewerberinnen und Bewerber
  • Du nutzt Active Sourcing gezielt für Positionen, bei denen dieser Ansatz sinnvoll ist
Employer Branding
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns authentischen Recruiting-Content
  • Du machst unsere Arbeitswelt, unsere Unternehmenskultur und unsere Karrieremöglichkeiten sichtbar
  • Du entwickelst Ideen für Social-Media- und Employer-Branding-Aktivitäten und setzt diese eigenständig um


Das bist Du

  • Berufserfahrung im Recruiting, Talent Acquisition, Performance Recruiting oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion
  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie und wo sich unterschiedliche Zielgruppen erreichen lassen
  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Recruitingkanälen, Social Recruiting oder Performance Marketing ist ein großes Plus
  • Du denkst analytisch und hast Spaß daran, Recruiting anhand von Zahlen und KPIs zu steuern
  • Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig, probierst neue Ansätze aus und optimierst bestehende Prozesse
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und kannst Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten für unser Unternehmen begeistern
  • Du kommunizierst souverän mit Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern sowie Führungskräften
  • Du bist strukturiert, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert


Was uns überzeugt

Noch wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf: Du hast Lust, Recruiting neu zu denken und Dinge auszuprobieren.


Das bieten wir Dir

  • Top-moderne Ausstattung für effektives Arbeiten
  • Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten – ob von zuhause oder unterwegs
  • Ein wachsendes Unternehmen, in dem du die Zukunft aktiv mitgestalten kannst
  • Ein strukturiertes Onboarding, das dich schnell ins Team integriert
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege, damit deine Ideen direkt umgesetzt werden können
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungen für deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung


Unsere Benefits

  • Jobticket-Optionen, damit du stressfrei zur Arbeit kommst
  • Ein zentraler Arbeitsplatz mitten in der Kölner Südstadt
  • Bring deinen Hund einfach mit ins Büro – wir lieben Vierbeiner
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und lockere Get-togethers für den Teamspirit
  • Corporate Benefits mit Rabatten auf Freizeit, Mode, Wohnen, Technik, Reisen und vieles mehr
  • Und natürlich bieten wir dir auch Klassiker wie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge

title: Scrum Master / Delivery Enabler (m/w/d) - KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung
description: Du begeisterst dich für agile Delivery und willst die sich wandelnde Rolle des Scrum Masters im KI-Zeitalter aktiv mitgestalten? Und, du bist an vielfältigen Projekten in einem kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld interessiert? Dann schau dir MaibornWolff einmal näher an! Wir bei MaibornWolff sind ein inhabergeführtes, mittelständisches IT-Beratungsunternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Expertise. Mit rund 800 Tech-begeisterten Menschen beraten wir unsere Kunden bei ihren Digitalisierungsstrategien und entwickeln moderne, individuelle Softwarelösungen. 2024 sind wir in die Lünendonk-Liste der „ führenden mittelständischen IT-Beratungen in Deutschland " aufgestiegen, worauf wir sehr stolz sind. In unserer Delivery-Enabler Gilde arbeiten aktuell elf Scrum Master:innen, Agile Coaches und Delivery Enabler an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland. Unsere Mission: Delivery Enablement als starke, zukunftsfähige Rolle etablieren und Projekt-Teams auch im KI-Wandel wirksam unterstützen. Wir teilen Wissen, gestalten unsere Rolle gemeinsam weiter und bringen unterschiedliche Stärken ein. Unsere Projekte reichen von einzelnen Entwicklungsteams bis hin zu internationalen Programmen in Branchen wie Automotive, Energie und Public Sector. Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als Delivery Enabler übernimmst du Verantwortung für eine Rolle im Umbruch, führst interdisziplinäre Teams durch den KI-Wandel und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Delivery Enablement zu einer starken, zukunftsfähigen Funktion weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Aufgaben Teams stärken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Entwicklungsteams zusammen: Du beseitigst Hindernisse, entwickelst konstruktive Arbeitsweisen weiter und förderst so effektive Teamstrukturen. Stakeholder steuern: Du bringst die unterschiedlichen Interessen von Team, Kunde und MaibornWolff aktiv zusammen und sorgst so für einen klaren, effizienten Entscheidungs- und Kommunikationsfluss. Delivery absichern: Anhand konkreter Kennzahlen machst du Wirkung und Wertbeitrag deiner Rolle sichtbar. Du schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Zielen und Erwartungen, beseitigst Hindernisse und adressierst mögliche Risiken frühzeitig. KI-Agenten integrieren: Du befähigst dein Team zur optimalen Einbindung von KI-Agenten und Tools und hast die damit verbundenen Prozess- und Kommunikationsverschiebungen im Blick. Du begleitest Teams und Kunden souverän durch KI-bedingte Change Prozesse. Bereich mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit deiner Delivery Enabler-Gilde entwickelst du unser Rollenverständnis weiter, teilst dein Wissen und treibst relevante Themen voran. Wenn du möchtest, engagierst du dich zusätzlich als Mentor:in in der Mitarbeitendenentwicklung oder in anderen internen Aufgaben. Dein Profil Ausbildung: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder IT - entscheidend ist für uns jedoch deine reale Projekterfahrung. Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3-5 Jahre relevante Projekterfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb der Softwareentwicklung mit. Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten. Methodenkompetenz: Du beherrschst agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder Kanban und bestenfalls auch Skalierungsmodelle wie SAFe, Nexus oder LeSS. Zudem bist du stark in Stakeholder-Management, Facilitation & Workshop-Design sowie in agilen Metriken und Forecasting. Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt. Tools: Du nutzt KI-Anwendungen routiniert und zielgerichtet für deine eigene Arbeitseffizienz. Zudem hast du durch deine Projektarbeit ein klares Verständnis zu Wirkweise und möglichen Fallstricken von KI in der Softwareentwicklung gewonnen. Reisebereitschaft: Du bist bereit, bei Bedarf bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche zu reisen – für Workshops, Team-Events oder den direkten Austausch mit Team und Kunden vor Ort. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.

  • Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.

  • Experience leading a delivery team rather than only a plan.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d)
description: eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Our approach combines laser schemes for cooling/initialization/readout, engineered magnetic-field gradient induced coupling (MAGIC) combined with microwave control for universal gate sets, and advanced quantum control techniques and dedicated firmware to work within the high-fidelity regime and below the error threshold of quantum error correction (QEC). A central objective of our technology roadmap is the realization of fault-tolerant quantum computing. To achieve this goal, we combine the above high-fidelity quantum hardware with microscopic physics-based modelling, hardware–software co-design, advanced characterization and benchmarking techniques, and detailed numerical simulations to model system performance realistically and identify the optimal QEC strategy and the associated system requirements. As part of our initiative towards fault-tolerant quantum computing, we are expanding our Foundations & Concepts team and are looking for a Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d) to help establish and grow this strategic activity within the company. Responsibilities:   Develop and drive fault-tolerant quantum-computing strategies and logical architectures for trapped-ion MAGIC quantum processors. Lead hardware-aware quantum error-correction studies and guide architectural decisions for future processor generations. Coordinate realistic performance models connecting hardware characterization, circuit-level noise models, and logical performance metrics. Work closely with System Architecture, System Operations, Software Engineering, and Quantum Applications teams to support the co-design of future fault-tolerant quantum computers. Mit dem OMR Festival veranstalten wir eines der weltweit größten Präsenz-Events für die Digital-Branche mit zuletzt rund 67.000 Besucher*innen in 2026. Schau dir jetzt das Recap unseres letzten OMR Festivals an! 

Das Crew Resource Management Team ist auf die erfolgreiche Durchführung des OMR Festivals spezialisiert und gewährleistet einen reibungslosen Ablauf durch hohe Expertise in der Dispositionsplanung, Arbeitsbereichsplanung und Personalkoordination. Mit dem Entwickeln und Implementieren innovativer Konzepte, bildet das Crew Resource Management Team die Brücke zwischen der Festival Crew und dem OMR Festival & Events Team.

Für die nächsten Festivals wollen wir noch besser aufgestellt sein und suchen ab Anfang Januar oder Februar 2027 bis ca. Ende Juni Unterstützung.


Wo du wirklich was bewegst


  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für einen oder mehrere Arbeitsbereiche der OMR Crew 
  • Du bist mitverantwortlich für die Dispositionsplanung der Festival Crew 
  • Du konzeptionierst und verfasst Briefings und Webtexte
  • Du unterstützt in der täglichen Planung des Crew Managements, sowie bei der Planung und Durchführung von Personalschulungen
  • Du führst eigenständig Mitarbeiter*innen während des Events 
  • Du hilfst bei der Rekrutierung der Crew des OMR Festivals 2027


Was dich auszeichnet


  • Du stehst für ein ca. 5-6-monatiges Praktikum zur Verfügung 
  • Du hast eine positive Einstellung, eine kommunikative Art und eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe 
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 
  • Du bist flexibel und hast Lust das Festival mitzugestalten
  • Du hast Freude am täglichen Umgang mit Menschen, sowie ein sicheres und überzeugendes Auftreten
Nice-to-have: Du hast erste Erfahrungen im Eventmanagement und/oder im Personalmanagement.


Was für dich drin ist


  • Die Möglichkeit, dich in einem der spannendsten deutschen Medienunternehmen einzubringen
  • Ein Wohlfühl-Office mit höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Massage-Sesseln, Mini-Gym, Sommer-Deck uvm. direkt im Hamburger Schanzenviertel
  • Von unserem Campus-Team frisch zubereitete Leckereien sowie großes Müsli- und Getränkeangebot 
  • Firmenfitness über EGYM Wellpass, Mental-Health-Angebote von nilo und betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und heycare für die Betreuung von Kids, Vierbeiner oder die Pflege von Angehörigen und mehr Vereinbarkeit im Alltag
  • Fahrrad-Leasing, Zuschuss zur HVV-Proficard, JobAuto und Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Partnerprodukte
  • Zugang zu allen OMR-Weiterbildungsformaten und eine steile Lernkurve in digitalen Themenfeldern
  • Die Gelegenheit, dich über den OMR Kosmos mit den Player*innen der Digitalszene zu vernetzen



Wenn du zukünftig mit guter Laune ins Büro fahren willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Bitte schick ein kurzes Anschreiben, deinen Lebenslauf und deine Gehaltsvorstellung an Julia Thiele.

OMR setzt sich für Chancengleichheit, Vielfalt und Integration am Arbeitsplatz ein. Wir unterbinden Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeder Art aufgrund von Geschlecht, Hautfarbe, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderung, geschlechtlicher Identität oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen. 

Come and be as you are.

Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design. Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch. Nice to Have, aber kein Muss DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt. KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht. Warum wir? Code. Chill. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an. Dein Stack, dein Style: Wir stehen auf smarte Lösungen, sauberen Code und Menschen, die mitdenken. Dein Bürohund ist bei uns genauso willkommen wie dein Lieblingseditor. Professionalität: echte Qualität statt Show-off. Wir leben agile Entwicklung mit klaren Iterationen und direktem Feedback. Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln. Was es gibt: eine Architekturfunktion, Boards und Communities, Quellsysteme mit Daten. Was fehlt, ist die Person, die daraus ein System macht, das sich selbst trägt. Du führst regelmäßige Prozessreviews durch, planst und setzt Tool-Updates und Funktionserweiterungen um und passt das Architektur-Metamodell an veränderte Anforderungen an. Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.</li> <li>Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.</li> <li>Develop rigorous evaluations&nbsp;covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token.&nbsp;Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.</li> <li>Work&nbsp;with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to&nbsp;select research priorities with measurable production impact.</li> <li>Share results through&nbsp;internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source&nbsp;artifacts, and mentor&nbsp;engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system&nbsp;trade-offs.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>A&nbsp;PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.</li> <li>Strong Python and&nbsp;PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.</li> <li>Deep&nbsp;knowledge&nbsp;of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving&nbsp;trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong experimental design&nbsp;skills covering&nbsp;ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>First-author publications&nbsp;at venues such as&nbsp;NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or&nbsp;HPCA.</li> <li>Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.</li> <li>Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.</li> <li>Experience&nbsp;applying&nbsp;post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.</li> <li>Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, technical blogs, or invited talks&nbsp;demonstrating contributions to&nbsp;efficient AI systems.</li> <li>Research or implementation experience in one or more areas of distributed inference system architecture, such as LLM request routing, PDD, multi-node serving, or MoE expert parallelism, including WideEP.</li> </ul><div   • The chance to define the product experience of a category, building the interfaces through which researchers, patients, and communities fund and govern science

  • A team that values substance over titles, speed over process, and people who’ve built their way up

title: Senior Payroll Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for an experienced <strong>Senior Payroll Analyst</strong> to join our Global Payroll team and play a key role in the delivery and continuous improvement of payroll across our international markets.</p> <p>This is a senior operational role with responsibility for overseeing payroll activity across multiple countries. You will bring strong payroll expertise, sound judgement and a proactive approach to ensure employees are paid accurately, on time and in compliance with local legislation.</p> <p>Working closely with the Payroll Team, internal HR and People teams, Finance, Tax and external payroll providers, you will take ownership of complex payroll activities, provide subject-matter expertise and act as a key escalation point for payroll issues.</p> <p>The role will also provide opportunities to support <strong>international payroll projects, process improvements, system implementations and automation</strong>, helping Deliveroo build a scalable and efficient global payroll operation.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Take ownership of the <strong>end-to-end payroll delivery</strong> for assigned international entities.</li> <li>Partner with local HR, People Operations, Finance and Tax teams to ensure payroll inputs are complete, accurate and delivered within agreed timelines.</li> <li>Review, validate and approve payroll inputs and outputs, identifying discrepancies, trends and potential risks before payroll is finalised.</li> <li>Apply a strong understanding of <strong>legislation across multiple jurisdictions, statutory requirements and payroll practices</strong>, ensuring processes remain compliant and appropriately controlled.</li> <li>Work closely with external payroll providers, holding them accountable for <strong>accuracy, timeliness, compliance and service delivery</strong>.</li> <li>Act as a senior escalation point for complex employee and stakeholder payroll queries, providing clear guidance and appropriate resolutions.</li> <li>Perform and oversee payroll reconciliations, payment validation and statutory submissions, ensuring appropriate controls are completed and documented.</li> <li>Analyse payroll data and reporting to identify anomalies, control weaknesses, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.</li> <li>Maintain strong payroll governance and documentation, ensuring processes, controls and procedures are consistently followed.</li> <li>Proactively identify opportunities to <strong>simplify, standardise and automate payroll processes</strong>, reducing manual intervention and operational risk.</li> <li>Support and lead payroll-related projects, including <strong>system implementations, payroll migrations, integrations, process changes and new entity onboarding</strong>.</li> <li>Partner with Technology and payroll vendors to troubleshoot system and integration issues and support effective resolution.</li> <li>Contribute to the development of payroll policies, procedures, controls and best practices across international markets.</li> <li>Share knowledge and provide guidance to Payroll Analysts and other team members, helping to build capability and consistency across the wider team.</li> <li>Stay up to date with changes to payroll legislation and communicate relevant impacts to internal stakeholders and payroll providers.</li> <li>Support the Payroll Lead with wider global payroll initiatives and deputise where required.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Significant experience working in a <strong>payroll analyst or senior payroll position</strong>, ideally within a complex, international organisation.</li> <li>Strong hands-on experience of <strong>international payroll</strong>, with experience of <strong>Italy and/or France payroll highly desirable</strong>.</li> <li>Good working knowledge of Italian and/or French payroll legislation, statutory requirements and payroll processes is preferable.</li> <li>Experience managing payroll across multiple countries and working with <strong>third-party payroll providers</strong>.</li> <li>Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations, payments, statutory reporting and compliance.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate payroll data, identify discrepancies and understand the root cause of issues.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on payroll accuracy and risk management.</li> <li>Experience of identifying and implementing <strong>process improvements, automation and operational efficiencies</strong>.</li> <li>Experience supporting or leading payroll projects, system implementations or payroll migrations.</li> <li>Strong Excel skills and confidence working with payroll data and reporting.</li> <li>Experience with <strong>Workday/Cloudpay</strong> or other HR/payroll technology is preferred.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge, influence and provide a clear point of view.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex payroll matters clearly to both payroll and non-payroll stakeholders.</li> <li>A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the confidence to question <strong>the why and the how</strong> behind existing processes.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Deliveroo?</strong></h2> <p>Deliveroo’s mission is to build the definitive food company by making food more convenient and accessible.</p> <p>As a technology-driven business in one of the world’s fastest-growing industries, Deliveroo offers the opportunity to make a real impact while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.</p> <p>Deliveroo also offers a wide range of competitive benefits across health, family, finance, community, convenience, growth, time away and relocation.</p> <h2><strong>Workplace and diversity</strong></h2> <p>Deliveroo is committed to building a workplace that reflects the diversity of the world around us and where everyone can belong.</p> <p>There is no judgement when it comes to the things that make people who they are — whether that is gender, race, sexuality, religion or even a secret aversion to coriander.</p> <p>If you are passionate about food and excited to help shape one of the fastest-growing companies in an exciting space, Deliveroo would love to hear from you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.</p> <p>If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><em data-renderer-mark="true"><br>Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at</em> <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _2rkolb4i _ect4ttxp _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="http://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-renderer-mark="true" data-is-router-link="false" data-testid="link-with-safety"><em data-renderer-mark="true">careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness</em></a><em data-renderer-mark="true">.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our People team are looking for an experienced Senior HR Advisor to join the team.</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p>Working in our global HR Business Partnering team to actively support the partnership and advise across the partner lifecycle globally and contribute towards the successful delivery of the partner&nbsp;agenda and value proposition. Activities will include: <ul> <li>Investigations, conduct concerns, grievances and partner transitions (exits).</li> <li>Absence and wellbeing management (including short and long term sickness), monitoring absence levels, sick pay, support in coordinating return to work plans and providing proactive support/advice to the Chief People Officer and senior leadership.</li> <li>Engaging with occupational health and other external service providers in a timely manner.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Escalate complex/sensitive queries to the Head of HRBPs for advice, guidance and support.</li> <li>Work closely with the HR Operations team and HR Systems team to design, document and continuously improve partnership HR processes and ways of working (e.g. Standard Operating Procedures, process maps, workflow tools), ensuring they remain fit for a partnership model and scale as the business grows.</li> <li>Responsible for completing regular reviews and updates to the Partner policies and Partnership People handbook.</li> <li>Manage the Director to Partner promotions process, working closely with the Head of Leadership Development and HR Business Partners accordingly.</li> <li>Manage and coordinate the execution of the Partner Year End review process, ensuring relevant assets and communications are updated, systems and processes are in place and responding to queries.</li> <li>Collate, monitor and analyse people data for themes and trends, producing high quality insights as requested.</li> <li>Support/coordinate/lead on relevant special projects across the Partner Experience Team.</li> <li>Collaborate and build strong relationships with the Chief People Officer and global HR team for support, guidance, and upskilling opportunities.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years’ experience working in a generalist HR role within a fast-paced HR team, specifically with proven employee relations experience and sound knowledge of employment legislation, complex case management and HR best practice.</li> <li>The ability to adapt experience to a partnership model, including an understanding of (or willingness to quickly build) knowledge of partnership-specific structures such as LLP member agreements, partner governance and exit mechanics, which differ from standard employee contracts.</li> <li>Proven experience working closely with senior stakeholders across a variety of HR topics</li> <li>Proven experience in process improvement and working within HR systems, case management and workflow/automation tools.</li> <li>Adept at stakeholder management including relationship building, communication and influencing skills.</li> <li>Highly accountable and organised with rigorous attention to detail.</li> <li>Emotionally intelligent and able to adapt in emotive and stressful situations.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> title: Lead UX Designer - Star Trek Fleet Command
description: <p>Scopely is looking for a <strong>Lead UX Designer</strong> to join our Star Trek Fleet Command team within our Live Games Portfolio division in the UK on a remote basis.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.</p> <p>Star Trek Fleet Command is a standout success in the gaming industry. Launched in 2018, our in-house developed 4X Strategy MMO has continually evolved, earning its place as one of the top-grossing games on the market.</p> <h3>What You Will Do</h3> <ul> <li>Set design standards, best practices, and strategic UX vision for Star Trek Fleet Command, defining the craft direction across complex 4X systems.</li> <li>Own and champion complete, aspirational UX for new features and player experiences, transforming complex product requirements into intuitive, engaging flows.</li> <li>Build deep knowledge of the game to effectively step into the player’s shoes and ground your design decisions in real player perspectives and experiences.</li> <li>Find relevant references and comps, deconstructing them to uncover inspiration and common pitfalls.</li> <li>Visualise ideas by producing a range of design deliverables that communicate your thinking and design intent. This includes sketches, low to medium fidelity wireframes, user flows, and interactive UX prototypes.</li> <li>Identify weak points in designs, gaps in thinking, and opportunities to better deliver on goals by applying critical thinking and a sharp design eye to strengthen solutions.</li> <li>Work closely with product teams, game designers and artists to refine ideas and stay aligned throughout development. Proactively share work, keep the right people informed, and provide relevant information when it’s needed.</li> <li>Leverage feedback, data, and other insights to refine designs—not just to react, but to reflect and make intentional improvements.</li> <li>Support long-term product and UX consistency through your design work by drawing on developed knowledge of our design principles and patterns.</li> </ul> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>Proven track record of leadership in Game UX, with extensive experience designing for complex, deep systems in live-service F2P games (4X or strategy experience highly preferred).</li> <li>Strong mentorship and leadership capabilities, with experience guiding and developing team members, reviewing work to maintain high craft quality, and managing performance effectively.</li> <li>A solutions-oriented mindset that goes beyond identifying problems, bringing thoughtful, creative problem solving to the table.</li> <li>A strong understanding of game development norms and pipelines, including how to design with technical constraints, implementation realities, and cross-discipline workflows in mind.</li> <li>A fit for a culture built on curiosity, improvement, creativity, and collaboration, paired with a genuine passion for both playing and making games that fuels thoughtful, player-centered design.</li> </ul> <p>At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! &nbsp; We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us &amp; embrace the adventure!</p> <p>Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. 🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business
🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time
🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our GTM Talent Partner, you'll own hiring across a broad commercial area of Checkatrade, partnering closely with our leaders to find the people who'll help us get there.

We're a lean, hands-on Talent team, so this is much bigger than picking up reqs. You'll properly own your space: understanding the business, challenging what we actually need, using data to influence decisions and making our hiring and processes better as you go.

The job, unfiltered:

  • Own end-to-end hiring across our GTM organisation, with a particular focus across Sales, Account Management, Revenue and Commercial Operations.

  • Get properly under the skin of the areas you support: how they work, how they make money, what they're trying to achieve and the talent they need to get there.

  • Partner with senior commercial leaders, building enough trust to challenge a brief, push back on an unrealistic expectation and bring a point of view rather than simply taking an order.

  • Run multiple searches at once without losing pace, quality or candidate experience.

  • Build strong passive pipelines and talent pools so we're not starting from zero every time a role lands.

  • Use data to understand what's actually happening in your hiring. Think pipeline health, application sources, conversion rates, pass-through, rejection themes and market insight - then use it to recommend what we do differently.

  • Use AI and modern tooling to make sourcing, screening, analysis and the wider hiring process smarter and more efficient.

  • Keep Ashby useful and accurate. We actually use our hiring data to make decisions, so good ATS hygiene matters.

  • Spot things that aren't working and help us fix them. You'll have space to improve processes, test new tools and challenge the way we've always done things.

  • Get involved in wider TA projects across data, automation, tooling, employer brand and candidate experience.

  • Be part of the wider People team, working closely with People Partners and other teams rather than operating in a TA bubble.

Basically, you'll hire great people, but you'll also help us build a better Talent function while you're doing it.

The fit:

The environment you've worked in matters to us. We're particularly keen to meet people who've been in-house in a fast-paced tech, scale-up or high-growth business, ideally as part of a lean Talent team where you've had genuine ownership of an area rather than one small part of the process.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Strong in-house Talent experience within a fast-moving tech or high-growth environment.

  • Solid GTM/commercial hiring experience, particularly across Sales, Account Management, Revenue or Commercial Operations.

  • Experience working in a lean TA environment where you've owned hiring end-to-end and contributed beyond your individual reqs.

  • Confidence partnering with senior commercial stakeholders who will challenge you and expect you to know your stuff.

  • A genuinely data-led approach. You can use hiring metrics, pipeline data and market insight to diagnose a problem, tell a clear story and influence a decision.

  • Strong sourcing skills and the confidence to proactively find great passive talent rather than relying on inbound applications.

  • Experience managing multiple priorities in an environment where things move quickly and the brief isn't always perfectly formed.

  • Curiosity around AI, automation and new recruiting technology, with hands-on experience using tools to make your work better.

  • Strong organisation and communication. You keep things moving and don't let the important stuff fall through the cracks.

  • A low ego and high standards. You'll challenge when you need to, take feedback well and care about making the whole team better.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

What you get

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme
🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support
🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme
🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme
❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

How this goes

Talent chat → an initial conversation with our Talent team to get to know each other, give you the full context on Checkatrade and understand what you're looking for next.

1st stage → a deeper conversation around your GTM hiring experience, stakeholder partnering, how you use data and what you've owned in previous Talent teams.

title: Junior Mechanical Engineer
description: THE LAST FRONTIER Arctic Research and Development (ARD) was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk. THE ROLE ARD is growing and we’re looking for a Junior Mechanical Engineer to support the design, build and deployment of our ruggedized hardware products - from-field ready energy systems to autonomous surface and subsurface platforms. You'll join our mechanical engineering team, which designs, builds and tests the hardware that has to operate reliably in the Arctic. You'll report to our Lead Mechanical Engineer and work closely with our Mechanical Engineer and CTO. You'll start hands-on, building and testing units, then feed what you learn back into design updates. Within your first 6-12 months, your work will let us build and test properly, and expand bandwidth to launch further products in parallel. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Build and assemble product units through our first multi-unit production run, taking on hands-on workshop tasks to get units completed to standard and on schedule. Run test phases alongside each build and record the results, so issues are found and fixed before units reach customers. Turn what you learn on the workshop floor into design improvements, working with our Senior Mechanical Engineer on updates to parts and assemblies. Produce engineering drawings and CAD models, and carry out the calculations on loads and forces that support design decisions. Move on to additional products once builds of our current product are established, applying the same build, test and improvement cycle. ABOUT YOU You're a mechanical engineer who understands a design best by building it. You're happy doing practical work in the workshop, and you want to grow into design engineering, using what you learn hands-on to make the next version better. You might be coming from an engineering degree apprenticeship, a graduate development programme, or a technician or shop-floor role where you've started taking on design work. REQUIREMENTS Essential A degree in mechanical engineering (BEng or above), a completed engineering degree apprenticeship, or equivalent engineering training. Hands-on experience building, assembling or fabricating mechanical assemblies in a workshop or production setting. Ability to understand how forces and loads act on a design and carry out engineering hand calculations. Ability to produce engineering drawings and 3D models in CAD. Willingness to make practical build and technician work a core part of your role, alongside design work. Comfortable owning tasks on a project with guidance from senior engineers, and raising problems early when a build or test doesn't go to plan. Desirable Experience planning or running physical tests on mechanical hardware and writing up the results. Experience building products in small batches or repeat runs, rather than one-off prototypes. Why ARD The mission - The Arctic is the fastest-changing region on Earth. You'll build the intelligence layer that helps understand and steward it — an early-warning system for the planet's coldest edge. Early stage, real influence - ARD is at an exciting early stage. You'll join while our products, team and culture are still taking shape, and your ideas will directly influence where we go next. Ownership and accountability - We give people real responsibility from day one. You'll own your work end to end, be trusted to make decisions, and be accountable for delivering results that ship and get used. A small but growing team - You'll work closely with experienced colleagues across science, software and hardware, with no layers in between. As we grow, you'll help build the team and the ways of working that come next. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive compensation Private Health Insurance from Day 1 Dental & Vision Equity - meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company Real field exposure - travel to Arctic sites and Outposts when needed Mission-driven culture - focus on impact, not hours logged ARD is an equal opportunities employer. We hire on merit, based on skills, experience and potential, and welcome applications from everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. We know great candidates sometimes hold back unless they tick every box, so if this role excites you but your experience doesn’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you, especially if you bring a background or perspective that is under-represented in science and engineering. About the Opportunity

Every transaction we process requires a real-time decision. Declining a legitimate transaction leaves a customer stuck at the point of purchase, while approving a fraudulent one carries a direct cost.

This role owns the decisioning system and underlying platform. From the serving path and feature infrastructure to the underlying models and the machinery required to make safe, live updates. You will continuously improve the platform and our day to day workflows, rather than treating these as secondary projects.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. You will be part of a team that builds, ships, and maintains the entire machine learning lifecycle.

Our main focus is fraud detection and prevention, an adversarial domain where opponents constantly adapt and feedback arrives in the form of financial impact. Alongside, this we build broader capabilities to enable machine learning across Moonpay.

Lead through ambiguity

  • Turn vague problems into well-defined solutions and bring people with you.

  • Set the technical bar through rigorous reviews, clear standards, and lasting engineering habits.

Build and scale the platform

  • Develop feature infrastructure across batch, near-real-time, and in-request paths, managing specific freshness budgets for each.

  • Maintain alignment between training and serving to ensure models behave in production exactly as they did offline.

  • Integrate feedback loops to capture every decision and its outcome, including blocked transactions where results are counterfactual.

  • Scale the platform as volume and model complexity grow, ensuring operational load remains manageable.

Decide in real time

  • Own the services that score transactions in-flight, inside a hard latency budget

  • Design the degraded paths: what we answer when the model can't, and who agreed that policy

Ship safely, continuously

  • Mature the replay, shadow and staged-rollout tooling until changing a live model is routine and reversible

  • Own models across their lifecycle, from training through to retirement, and catch decay long before losses confirm it

Must-have experience and skills

  • Real-time serving. You have built and operated high-availability services that execute within strict latency budgets on critical paths, and you’ve designed robust fallback mechanisms

  • Systems thinking. You view the architecture holistically: identifying failure points, managing graceful degradation, and ensuring the system remains responsive even when dependencies fail. You build the feedback loops that allow a system to learn from its own decisions.

  • Engineering craft. You write code other people are happy to inherit — tested, typed, and correct when events arrive twice, late, or out of order. Adding the next feature to something you built is fast and painless.

  • Pipelines in production. You have owned feature or data pipelines end-to-end, including troubleshooting cases where offline and production metrics diverged and resolving the underlying discrepancies.

  • Ambiguity and influence. You've taken a problem nobody had scoped and turned it into work that shipped, and raised the level of the engineers around you while doing it.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Decision explainability. You've built systems where the reason for a decision mattered as much as the decision: audit trails, per-layer attribution, llm-driven analyses, or defending a model's behaviour to a non-technical audience.

  • Anomaly detection. You have developed systems to detect novel attack patterns and emerging abuse without existing labels, identifying suspicious behavior relative to historical baselines.

  • Familiarity with our stack: GCP, BigQuery, Bigtable, Memorystore, Vertex AI, Kubernetes.

We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.</p></div><p><b>About Us</b><br>Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.<br><br>Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.<br><br>Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.<br><br>As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. You'll be working across two theatres and several time zones. title: Senior Accountant
description: <h1>Senior Accountant</h1> <p>Location: UK, Manchester ( Hybrid)</p> <h2>About Inizio</h2> <p>Inizio is a global partner to health and life sciences organisations, delivering specialist expertise across the product and patient journey. Through Global Finance Services (GFS), we provide high-quality, efficient and compliant finance operations that support business performance worldwide.</p> <h2>Role Overview</h2> <p>Reporting to the Divisional Controller, we are seeking a Senior Accountant to lead accurate and timely period-end close activities within our Global Finance Services (GFS) shared services organisation. You will act as a subject matter expert across Record-to-Report (RTR) processes including journal preparation, balance sheet reconciliations, intercompany accounting and variance analysis while driving accounting quality, financial control and continuous improvement. Working closely with finance stakeholders, you will support governance, audit readiness and the development of junior team members.</p> <h2>Here's what you'll be doing</h2> <h3>Financial Accounting &amp; Close</h3> <ul> <li>Perform and oversee complex accounting activities, reconciliations and financial reporting support processes.</li> <li>Own key balance sheet accounts and ensure timely reconciliation and resolution of outstanding items.</li> <li>Review and sign off bank reconciliations.</li> <li>Oversee intercompany accounting and resolution of differences.</li> <li>Lead assigned month-end, quarter-end and year-end close activities.</li> <li>Review accounting transactions and escalate issues where appropriate.</li> <li>Prepare and review variance analysis, providing clear commentary on movements in assigned balance sheet accounts and period-end results.</li> <li>Prepare and review schedules and supporting information for internal and external reporting requirements, ensuring accuracy and completeness ahead of submission deadlines.</li> </ul> <h3>Governance &amp; Controls</h3> <ul> <li>Support reporting requirements, accounting policy implementation and process changes.</li> <li>Support internal and external audits.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, controls and reporting quality.</li> <li>Support the Divisional Controller in delivering accounting, governance and financial control objectives.</li> </ul> <h3>Leadership</h3> <ul> <li>Coach and support Accountants in the execution of accounting activities and capability development; this is not a line management responsibility but carries an expectation of technical leadership and work review.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <h3>Qualifications &amp; Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree (or equivalent professional qualification) in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or related discipline.</li> <li>Qualified ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent preferred.</li> <li>4–8 years' progressive finance experience including financial accounting, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, close activities, audit support and financial controls.</li> <li>Experience within a global Shared Services Centre (SSC) or Global Business Services (GBS) environment is essential.</li> </ul> <h3>Technical &amp; Operational Expertise</h3> <ul> <li>ERP experience (Oracle Fusion or similar).</li> <li>Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.</li> <li>Strong accounting standards, financial reporting and balance sheet management knowledge.</li> <li>Knowledge of internal controls and SOX or equivalent governance.</li> <li>Experience supporting process improvement or automation.</li> </ul> <h3>Problem Solving &amp; Innovation</h3> <ul> <li>Resolve complex reconciliations, intercompany disputes and accounting issues.</li> <li>Apply judgement to non-routine transactions.</li> <li>Drive process improvements and control enhancements.</li> </ul> <h3>Stakeholder Management &amp; Communication</h3> <ul> <li>Build effective relationships with Finance, Tax, Treasury, Audit and Divisional teams.</li> <li>Communicate technical accounting matters clearly.</li> </ul> <h3>Performance, Impact &amp; Ways of Working</h3> <ul> <li>High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.</li> <li>Collaborative, proactive and committed to continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <h2>Why join us</h2> <p>You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality financial reporting and strengthening accounting controls across Global Finance Services while supporting continuous improvement and operational excellence.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-DT2 #LI-HYBRID</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="elementToProof"><em>Don't meet every job requirement? You may be just the right person for this role or others.</em></div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Global Campaigns
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://customers.twilio.com/" data-sk="tooltip_parent">&nbsp;hundreds of thousands of businesses&nbsp;</a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p> <p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p> <p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p> <p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!&nbsp;</p> <p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.&nbsp;<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p> <p>Join the team as Twilio’s next Director of Global Campaigns.</p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>As the head of the Twilio Global Campaign team, you are responsible for owning, developing and executing the major campaigns that drive awareness and opportunities for Twilio. This role is highly cross functional, working closely with both internal marketing partners across regions, sales, product, and company leadership to design end-to-end campaigns that deliver on business objectives. You possess a proven track record of leading multi-channel global campaigns with success, collaborating with stakeholders, and finding opportunities to strategically uplevel Twilio’s campaign engine.&nbsp;</p> <p>The ideal candidate has an advanced understanding of how campaigns resonate with a global audience, not just one country. You are skilled in understanding the modern AI-driven buyer journey at each stage of the funnel, have the ability to translate messaging frameworks into effective campaigns, and thrives in a collaborative environment. You recognize the value of running an integrated campaign motion, and have the ability to think both strategically and execute at an operational level with ease. Your performance will be measured by your ability to execute and achieve measurable results including building brand awareness, developing a system of content and assets that is valuable to all regions, and building campaigns that accelerate growth velocity.&nbsp;</p> <p><br><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Set a strategic vision</strong> for global campaign structure, operations, and execution for our top 5 campaign motions. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . What we're looking for Omnea is scaling fast after our Series B, and Sales hiring is one of the biggest levers on our growth. We're looking for a Head of GTM Recruitment to own how we hire across Sales. You'll lead a team of recruiters across the UK and US, while still running your own searches. Your focus starts in the UK and EMEA, and grows with us as global roles open up. This is a 50/50 player-coach role. Half your time goes on building the team, the playbook and the partnerships with Sales leadership. The other half goes on doing the work: mapping, outreach, screening and closing the most senior and critical hires yourself. We're building a very different kind of talent function, focused on quality and care over volume and speed. You'll set the standard for what that looks like. What can you expect? Lead the team You'll lead, coach and grow a team of recruiters across London and New York, setting clear goals and holding a high bar on quality. You'll hire into your own team as hiring scales, deciding where we need recruiters, sourcers or coordinators. You'll take the time to differentiate the UK and US hiring engines to reflect local challenges and optimisation. Build the engine You'll own the hiring plan with sales leadership, forecasting headcount, prioritising roles and keeping us on target. You'll build the Sales hiring playbook: role specs, success profiles, interview stages, scorecards and closing approach. You'll own the numbers. Pipeline health, conversion by stage, time to hire, offer acceptance and quality of hire, reported to leadership and used to make decisions. You'll get the most out of our tooling and AI so the team spends its time on candidates, not admin. You'll prepare the function for global hiring as we open roles in new markets. Hire the best You'll personally run the most senior and critical sales searches, from mapping to close. You'll be a trusted partner to our sales leaders, shaping role specs and challenging hiring decisions with data. You'll build Omnea's reputation in the GTM talent market: invite-only events, investor networks, and becoming the go-to person for exceptional sales hires. About you You've got 8+ years in recruitment, with a strong GTM focus in high-growth startups or agencies placing into them. At least 2 of those years were spent leading recruiters. You love being on the tools and you'll happily own a senior search while coaching your team through theirs. You run the function on data. You know your funnel, you spot problems early, and you use numbers to change minds. You hold your own with senior commercial leaders. You can push back on a spec, challenge a hiring decision and earn their trust. You've got a strong network in the European GTM and startup ecosystem. You're a ruthless prioritiser, highly organised and outcomes-focused. You use AI across your work and you never let the basics slip on process, comms and ATS hygiene. You're entrepreneurial. You want to build something, not run something that already exists. And you're a really good human: collaborative, kind and low-ego. You raise the bar for the people around you. At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
