Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche  articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.

Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.

L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.

🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’industrie du futur. 

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant qu’ Ingénieur(e), vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au Centre SPIN. Au sein de ce centre, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal afin de contribuer à l’atteinte des objectifs de neutralité carbone de la France.

Le centre SPIN est l’un des centres de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne dédié à la recherche en génie des procédés et rassemble environ 80 personnes comprenant enseignants-chercheurs, postdocs, doctorants, stagiaires, et profite du soutien de personnels administratifs et techniques. L’activité du centre SPIN s’inscrit dans le périmètre du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (UMR 5307) et du Laboratoire Environnement Ville et Société (UMR 5600).

 

Ce recrutement est au cœur de la stratégie d’innovation de Mines Saint-Etienne pour permettre à un brevet IMT de se concrétiser en une technologie permettant de capter le CO2 des fumées industrielles, et de contribuer ainsi à l’atteinte de l’objectif Français de Neutralité carbone

description: <h2><strong>Staff Product Manager – E-Commerce Web Upper Funnel [Permanent - CDI] (f/m/d)</strong></h2> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Paris or Lille, France</p> <p><strong>Team:</strong> Decathlon E-Commerce Web – Scope Upper Funnel</p> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>At the heart of Decathlon’s global digital ecosystem, our <strong>E-Commerce Web</strong> team builds the online destination for millions of sports lovers worldwide. The <strong>Upper Funnel</strong> scope is the front door of our digital experience: from landing on the homepage and navigating categories, to discovering products via search, AI-driven recommendations, conversational shopping, retail media placements, and inspiring content. Our mission is to seamlessly guide users from inspiration to intent.</p> <p>Joining this high-traffic Web Product organization means operating at massive scale where speed, discovery excellence, SEO, targeted monetization, and next-gen personalized user journeys drive our everyday business impact.</p> <h3><strong>YOUR FUTURE CONTRIBUTION</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Staff Product Manager – Upper Funnel</strong>, you will provide the strategic direction, functional architecture, and product leadership needed to scale and modernize the discovery and exploration experience across Decathlon's web platform. Operating with high autonomy, you will address complex challenges across search performance, catalog structuring, retail media integration, and emerging AI paradigm shifts like conversational interface models and agentic workflows.</p> <p>Your mission centers on 4 strategic pillars:</p> <h4><strong>1. Strategic Alignment, Stakeholder Management &amp; Upper Funnel Vision</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Own the Holistic Discovery &amp; Engagement Strategy</strong>: Define and drive the strategic vision for upper funnel web touchpoints (Homepage, Category/Listing Pages, Search Engine, Navigation Taxonomy, Retail Media Ad Placements, Conversational Assistants, and Inspiration Hubs).</li> <li><strong>Executive &amp; Cross-Functional Alignment</strong>: Partner with global business directors, commercial/merchandising leads, SEO specialists, retail media monetization teams, and AI platform engineering leads to align executive leadership around major web platform shifts and discovery roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Macro Metrics &amp; Funnel Performance</strong>: Track, measure, and optimize key upper funnel metrics across the customer journey: Organic/Direct Traffic, Search CTR, Category Depth, Conversational Engagement &amp; Intent Resolution Rate, Ad Yield/eCPM, Bounce Rate, Product Detail Page (PDP) Click-through Rate, and Top-of-Funnel Conversion.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>2. Functional Architecture &amp; Web Ecosystem Orchestration</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Functional Architect</strong>: Define boundary maps and functional scope across web squads (Search &amp; Conversational Discovery, Taxonomy &amp; Merchandising, Personalization/Recommendations, Retail Media &amp; Sponsored Listings) to eliminate overlap and friction.</li> <li><strong>Tight Triad Collaboration</strong>: Work in close sync with Staff/Principal Web Engineers and Staff UX/UI Designers to align frontend performance (Core Web Vitals), modular web design systems, micro-frontend architecture, conversational UI patterns, and backend search/ad-serving APIs.</li> <li><strong>Seamless Omnichannel &amp; Funnel Handoff</strong>: Ensure fluid transitions from external acquisition channels into the web upper funnel, balancing organic product discovery and agentic assistance with sponsored/retail media inventory while designing seamless handoffs toward the lower funnel (PDP, Cart &amp; Checkout).</li> </ul> <h4><strong>3. Strategic Sparring &amp; Product De-Risking</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Trusted Strategic Advisor</strong>: Serve as a sparring partner for Group Product Managers (GPMs) and Product Managers (PMs) within the Web &amp; E-Commerce domain, helping them navigate complex search algorithms, LLM agent architectures, ad server integrations, taxonomy dependencies, and high-volume web constraints.</li> <li><strong>De-Risking High-Stakes Initiatives</strong>: Formulate and execute validation strategies for high-risk discovery and monetization concepts (e.g., visual/voice search, conversational product advisors, agentic auto-replenishment/bundles, sponsored product placements).</li> <li><strong>Continuous Experimentation at Scale</strong>: Design and lead high-volume A/B and multivariate testing strategies, balancing conversational interaction models and ad impression density against organic conversion performance using CRO frameworks and Opportunity Solution Trees (OST).</li> </ul> <h4><strong>4. Elevating Product Craft &amp; Modern Web Capabilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>AI-First, Agentic &amp; Monetization Leadership</strong>: Champion the organizational adoption of cloud-native AI platforms (e.g., Google Vertex AI), conversational frameworks, agentic e-commerce patterns, and modern retail media capabilities to amplify both user experience and platform revenue.</li> <li><strong>Web Craft &amp; Best Practices</strong>: Upskill the PM community in modern web product practices, continuous discovery frameworks, technical web performance optimization, and data-informed decision-making.</li> <li><strong>Community Multiplier</strong>: Elevate the overall bar of the Product Management organization as a thought leader without acting as a direct line manager.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>E-Commerce Web Scale (7+ years)</strong>: Proven track record in Product Management with hands-on experience scaling high-traffic e-commerce web platforms (Upper Funnel, Search, Merchandising, or Navigation).</li> <li><strong>Upper Funnel &amp; SEO Expertise</strong>: Deep understanding of top-of-funnel mechanics, technical SEO, site search algorithms, taxonomy design, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).</li> <li><strong>Data &amp; Discovery Mastery</strong>: Strong expertise in web analytics (GA4/Amplitude/Contentsquare), high-traffic A/B testing frameworks, quantitative/qualitative user research, and Opportunity Solution Trees (OST).</li> <li><strong>Functional Architecture &amp; Scoping</strong>: Ability to decompose complex e-commerce catalog, ad-tech, and AI/search problems into modular MVP/V0/V1 execution strategies.</li> <li><strong>Executive Storytelling &amp; Alignment</strong>: Exceptional ability to translate complex search/agentic architectures, retail media revenue drivers, UX metrics, and conversion data into compelling narratives for executive stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Key Pluses &amp; Emerging Tech Strengths</strong>:</li> <ul> <li><strong>Google Vertex AI</strong>: Practical experience using Google Vertex AI (for Search, Recommendations, or custom ML/LLM model deployment) is a major plus.</li> <li><strong>Conversational &amp; Agentic E-Commerce</strong>: Solid understanding or experience with conversational AI interfaces (chat/voice product advisors) and agentic commerce concepts (autonomous intent-matching, task-oriented AI agents) is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Retail Media &amp; Monetization</strong>: Experience with Retail Media concepts and ad management (sponsored products, ad-server integrations, balancing yield vs. UX) is a major plus.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Soft Skills &amp; Leadership</strong>: Strong strategic influence, ability to thrive in ambiguity, passion for cross-functional collaboration in Triad, and an empathetic approach to mentoring junior PMs.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Hybrid Work Model</strong> (Paris or Lille base) 2 days of remote work per week</li> <li><strong>Tailored Equipment</strong> (Mac or Windows, according to mission and sustainability commitments);</li> <li><strong>Global Exposure</strong>: Local project team within a global retail and digital network with international career opportunities;</li> <li><strong>Continuous Growth</strong>: Internal/external trainings, skill development programs, and conference attendance;</li> <li><strong>Comprehensive Compensation</strong>: Competitive salary package including employee stock ownership, profit-sharing, and monthly/quarterly performance bonuses.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>DECATHLON DIGITAL CONTEXT&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>What if technology allowed us to push the boundaries and take sports experiences to new levels? That's exactly our goal at Decathlon Digital! We are a team of 5,000+ experts in software engineering, product management, data, cloud, and cybersecurity, distributed across Paris, Lille, and Amsterdam. Together, we are creating the largest digital sports platform, leveraging tech innovation from design to value chain optimization, connected experiences and product second life.</p> <p><br><strong>Changing the game for good</strong>. We are in this for the love of sports. And like everything we love, we want it to last. That’s why we are embarking on a journey to create a more sustainable tech model, reducing our direct environmental impact while maintaining a safe, diverse, and inclusive space for all our people to learn and thrive together. Team up with us to design the digital future of sports.</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The team Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all. We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write. European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it. The Role This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it. You will lead the team building our serverless containers product: the way developers run AI apps, MCP servers, APIs, and managed workers on our cloud without thinking about servers. Push a container, get an endpoint, scale from zero to thousands of instances and back down — across CPU and GPU. On a hyperscaler, the serverless layer is a product someone else built. Here you own it end to end: the scheduler that decides where a container lands, the routing path a request takes, the machinery that turns a scaled-to-zero service into a warm instance before a customer notices. All of it runs on metal, network, and datacenters we own. That tension is the product: scale-to-zero economics with cold starts in milliseconds, autoscaling that absorbs a launch spike without a config change, GPUs scheduled onto containers the way other platforms schedule CPU. The customers betting on this layer are the developers building the next generation of AI software on European infrastructure. What You Will Do Own the container platform end to end: image delivery, placement, request routing, scale-up, scale-to-zero — across CPU and GPU. Make cold starts a solved problem: snapshotting, prewarming, image-layer caching, whatever it takes for scale-from-zero to feel instant. Treat AI workloads as the normal case: GPU-backed containers, streaming responses, long-lived connections, MCP servers that cost almost nothing while idle. Write Go alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions. Grow the engineers, not just the software — set the standard for ownership and coach people past their comfort zone. Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback. Partner with Product Managers to turn platform decisions into a product developers want to deploy on. What We're Looking For 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write. You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped. You have built container or workload platforms — orchestration, scheduling, isolation, request routing — not just deployed onto someone else's serverless platform. Deep Linux: namespaces, cgroups, image layers, page cache — comfortable well below the application layer. Multi-tenancy instincts: density, isolation, and fairness when hundreds of customers share one fleet. Significant experience building complex backend or infrastructure systems. You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users. A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside. title: Fraud Manager - Data & IA (F/H)
description: Chez Younited, nous pensons que le crédit et les services bancaires devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique. C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent. Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de clients nous font confiance et près de 500 collaborateurs contribuent à notre développement dans 4 pays européens . Ce que nous construisons Younited Credit  : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients. Younited Pay  : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires. Younited Cashback  : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking. Younited Bank  : notre offre bancaire du quotidien, actuellement disponible via helios by Younited et en cours de déploiement. Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité. Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident Make it simple  : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence. Act as an entrepreneur  : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec. Innovate or die  : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître. Faster is better  : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat. No limit  : viser la lune tout en restant humble. Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe. Contexte 📄 Au sein de l’équipe Fraude, tu contribueras à la lutte contre la fraude externe à l’échelle du Groupe, présent en France, en Italie, en Espagne, au Portugal et en Allemagne.   Tu auras pour mission d’innover en mettant l’IA et la data au service de la détection et de la prévention de la fraude, de piloter la fraude par la donnée et de construire la lutte contre la fraude sur nos nouveaux produits.   Tu évolueras dans une organisation tech et en croissance, où la data et la technologie sont au cœur des décisions, en lien étroit avec les équipes Data, Tech, Produit et les équipes anti-fraude locales.   Missions 🚀 1) Définir et faire évoluer le système de détection de fraude Développer un dispositif antifraude efficace en collaboration avec les Business Units, les équipes Produit et Data, en t’inspirant des meilleures pratiques du marché Concevoir des parcours modulaires adaptés au niveau de risque de fraude, en optimisant l’équilibre entre friction et prévention Anticiper les risques de fraude liés au lancement des nouvelles offres bancaires et des programmes de cashback dès leur conception 2) Innover grâce à l’intelligence artificielle et à la veille technologique Suivre l’évolution des menaces et des technologies de lutte contre la fraude, identifier les solutions les plus prometteuses et formuler des recommandations Tester de nouvelles approches et piloter des POC Concevoir et déployer, avec les équipes Data, Tech et Produit, des outils intelligents pour automatiser la détection et faciliter le travail des analystes 3) Piloter la performance et harmoniser les pratiques à l’échelle du Groupe Construire et harmoniser les indicateurs de suivi de la fraude, développer les tableaux de bord et le reporting à destination du management Analyser les tendances pour anticiper les risques et proposer des plans d’action Travailler avec les équipes anti-fraude des différents pays pour partager les bonnes pratiques, contribuer à l’harmonisation des processus et suivre les évolutions réglementaires européennes et locales liées à la fraude À propos de toi 👇 Tu es diplômé.e d’un Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, de commerce, master data, statistiques ou risques), Tu justifies de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en lutte contre la fraude, gestion des risques, conformité ou data, idéalement en banque, cabinet de conseil ou fintech, Tu maîtrises Excel et SQL, et tu as une bonne pratique des outils d’IA (machine learning, IA générative) et de data visualisation, Tu connais bien les sujets de fraude au crédit et de  LCB-FT ; une expérience sur la fraude bancaire, aux moyens de paiement ou aux programmes de fidélité / cashback est un vrai plus, Tu es curieux.se, tu as le goût de la veille et tu fais preuve de rigueur analytique, Tu es autonome, de l’idée à la mise en production, et à l’aise dans un environnement international et transverse, Tu parles anglais couramment, une autre langue européenne (italien, espagnol, portugais) constitue un atout. Processus de recrutement 📅 Premier échange en visio avec Arthur,  Talent Acquisition Manager , pour apprendre à se connaître et échanger autour du poste, de tes motivations et de ton adéquation avec les valeurs et la culture Younited (30 min) Deuxième entretien en visio avec Baptiste, Responsable Risque Opérationnel , pour revenir sur ton parcours et échanger sur ta vision de la fraude et de l’IA (30 min) Étude de cas data et fraude à restituer à Baptiste suivie d’un échange avec tes futur.e.s collègues (90 min) Entretien final en visio avec Romain, Group Chief Risk & Data Officer (30 min) 🎁  Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ? Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement) Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome) Un état d’esprit entrepreneurial et un fort esprit d’équipe Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited Un environnement d’apprentissage continu avec la possibilité de bénéficier de formations externes et internes, plateforme de e-learning et des « Friday workshops » au sein de l'équipe Tech, pour accompagner le développement de chacun Une attention particulière à l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso Une charte de la parentalité pour soutenir tous les projets de famille à travers des mesures clés Pour t’accompagner dans les moments clés de ta vie personnelle, des congés exceptionnels souvent bien plus favorables que les dispositions légales Une politique de télétravail hybride 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine selon les équipes et la possibilité d’une semaine de full remote deux fois par an 33 jours de congés payés soit 8 de plus que les 25 jours légaux (à la place des traditionnelles RTT) Un abonnement à la plateforme Wellpass, ex Gymlib (+4000 activités sport et bien-être partout en France) à un tarif préférentiel  Carte tickets restaurant à hauteur de 10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur Des team buildings en France (Summer Party et Winter Party), à l’international et en équipe   Younited is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.     • Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.
    • Younited Bank : notre offre bancaire du quotidien, actuellement disponible via helios by Younited et en cours de déploiement.
Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident

    • Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence.
    • Act as an entrepreneur : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec.
    • Innovate or die : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître.
    • Faster is better : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat.
    • No limit : viser la lune tout en restant humble.
Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe.

Contexte 📄

Au sein de l’équipe Fraude, tu contribueras à la lutte contre la fraude externe à l’échelle du Groupe, présent en France, en Italie, en Espagne, au Portugal et en Allemagne.
 
Tu auras pour mission d’innover en mettant l’IA et la data au service de la détection et de la prévention de la fraude, de piloter la fraude par la donnée et de construire la lutte contre la fraude sur nos nouveaux produits.
 
Tu évolueras dans une organisation tech et en croissance, où la data et la technologie sont au cœur des décisions, en lien étroit avec les équipes Data, Tech, Produit et les équipes anti-fraude locales.
 

Missions 🚀

1) Définir et faire évoluer le système de détection de fraude
    • Développer un dispositif antifraude efficace en collaboration avec les Business Units, les équipes Produit et Data, en t’inspirant des meilleures pratiques du marché
    • Concevoir des parcours modulaires adaptés au niveau de risque de fraude, en optimisant l’équilibre entre friction et prévention
    • Anticiper les risques de fraude liés au lancement des nouvelles offres bancaires et des programmes de cashback dès leur conception

2) Innover grâce à l’intelligence artificielle et à la veille technologique
    • Suivre l’évolution des menaces et des technologies de lutte contre la fraude, identifier les solutions les plus prometteuses et formuler des recommandations
    • Tester de nouvelles approches et piloter des POC
    • Concevoir et déployer, avec les équipes Data, Tech et Produit, des outils intelligents pour automatiser la détection et faciliter le travail des analystes

3) Piloter la performance et harmoniser les pratiques à l’échelle du Groupe
    • Construire et harmoniser les indicateurs de suivi de la fraude, développer les tableaux de bord et le reporting à destination du management
    • Analyser les tendances pour anticiper les risques et proposer des plans d’action
    • Travailler avec les équipes anti-fraude des différents pays pour partager les bonnes pratiques, contribuer à l’harmonisation des processus et suivre les évolutions réglementaires européennes et locales liées à la fraude

À propos de toi 👇

    • Tu es diplômé.e d’un Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, de commerce, master data, statistiques ou risques),
    • Tu justifies de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en lutte contre la fraude, gestion des risques, conformité ou data, idéalement en banque, cabinet de conseil ou fintech,
    • Tu maîtrises Excel et SQL, et tu as une bonne pratique des outils d’IA (machine learning, IA générative) et de data visualisation,
    • Tu connais bien les sujets de fraude au crédit et de  LCB-FT ; une expérience sur la fraude bancaire, aux moyens de paiement ou aux programmes de fidélité / cashback est un vrai plus,
    • Tu es curieux.se, tu as le goût de la veille et tu fais preuve de rigueur analytique,
    • Tu es autonome, de l’idée à la mise en production, et à l’aise dans un environnement international et transverse,
    • Tu parles anglais couramment, une autre langue européenne (italien, espagnol, portugais) constitue un atout.

Processus de recrutement 📅

    • Premier échange en visio avec Arthur, Talent Acquisition Manager, pour apprendre à se connaître et échanger autour du poste, de tes motivations et de ton adéquation avec les valeurs et la culture Younited (30 min)
    • Deuxième entretien en visio avec Baptiste, Responsable Risque Opérationnel, pour revenir sur ton parcours et échanger sur ta vision de la fraude et de l’IA (30 min)
    • Étude de cas data et fraude à restituer à Baptiste suivie d’un échange avec tes futur.e.s collègues (90 min)
    • Entretien final en visio avec Romain, Group Chief Risk & Data Officer (30 min)

🎁 Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ?

  • Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)
  • Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome)
  • Un état d’esprit entrepreneurial et un fort esprit d’équipe
  • Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited
  • Un environnement d’apprentissage continu avec la possibilité de bénéficier de formations externes et internes, plateforme de e-learning et des « Friday workshops » au sein de l'équipe Tech, pour accompagner le développement de chacun
  • Une attention particulière à l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso
  • Une charte de la parentalité pour soutenir tous les projets de famille à travers des mesures clés
  • Pour t’accompagner dans les moments clés de ta vie personnelle, des congés exceptionnels souvent bien plus favorables que les dispositions légales
  • Une politique de télétravail hybride 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine selon les équipes et la possibilité d’une semaine de full remote deux fois par an
  • 33 jours de congés payés soit 8 de plus que les 25 jours légaux (à la place des traditionnelles RTT)
  • Un abonnement à la plateforme Wellpass, ex Gymlib (+4000 activités sport et bien-être partout en France) à un tarif préférentiel 
  • Carte tickets restaurant à hauteur de 10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur
  • Des team buildings en France (Summer Party et Winter Party), à l’international et en équipe

Vos missions Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes. Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp. Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels. Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat. Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp. Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits. Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain. Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes. Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux. Ce que nous recherchons Indispensable Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons. Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects. Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs. Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu. La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections. Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux. La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients. Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente. Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain. Rémunération Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés. Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner : Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions. Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème. Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème. Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans. Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables. Formation et accompagnement Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients. Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage. Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation. À la croisée de la stratégie, de l'orchestration et de l'exécution, vous porterez la vision marketing France auprès du Global et des instances exécutives locales, tout en veillant à ce que chaque campagne — globale ou locale — soit livrée avec excellence et dans les délais. Un leadership naturel pour fédérer, cadrer et orchestrer des sujets impliquant de nombreuses parties prenantes, sans lien hiérarchique direct sur la plupart d'entre elles. title: Director of rewards, data & analytics
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? As Director, Rewards & Data, you make pay, equity, benefits, workforce costs and People data work as one decision system You join the People Leadership Team and lead a team of three experts (Compensation; People Data & HR Cockpit; Cost Control & Workforce Planning), plus our Benefits and Immigration providers. Your mandate has two sides: Total Rewards — design and run a reward system (compensation, stock options and BSPCE, benefits, international mobility) that is competitive, fair, transparent and financially sustainable. People data and workforce economics — give leadership a reliable, shared view of headcount, people costs and workforce trends, and turn it into recommendations before decisions are made. What you'll do Build and lead the hub Set the hub's vision, roadmap and ways of working; lead and grow your three experts and manage specialist providers with clear accountability. Define who decides what with People Partners, Finance, Legal, Payroll and People Operations & Tech, and shape our People strategy as a member of the People Leadership Team. Own Total Rewards and compensation Own our reward philosophy and global compensation framework: job architecture, salary ranges, benchmarking and pay positioning. Lead the annual compensation review with Finance, and advise executives and People Partners on offers, promotions, retention and organisational changes. Monitor internal equity and market competitiveness, and get Back Market ready for the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Steer our equity programmes (stock options and BSPCE) Own equity principles, governance and the role of equity in total compensation, with Finance and Legal. Guarantee a reliable, documented and auditable lifecycle from grant to exit, and help employees understand and value their equity. Turn People data into decisions Own the HR Cockpit priorities and the definition of our key People metrics, built on Workday and aligned with company data standards. Co-steer workforce planning and the people cost trajectory with Finance (headcount, compensation, equity, benefits, contingent workers), with scenarios for organisational decisions. Shape benefits and international mobility Set the principles for global and local benefits and immigration, and manage providers on compliance, quality, cost and employee experience as we grow internationally. Keep it trustworthy Make sure reward decisions and sensitive data are handled with clear governance, approvals, auditability and data protection, and flag reward-related risks early. What you'll bring Significant experience leading a Total Rewards or Comp & Ben function in an international, multi-site company. Scale-up, tech or marketplace experience is a strong plus. Hands-on ownership of stock option and BSPCE programmes (or comparable French equity plans): governance, allocation and lifecycle. A track record of running people cost and headcount planning with Finance, and of building or rebuilding an HR data or analytics capability. Multi-country practice across Europe and at least one of the US or APAC, with working knowledge of pay transparency and pay equity requirements. Credibility with a CEO, a CFO and an Executive Committee: you bring fact-based recommendations and challenge constructively. Sound judgement balancing fairness, business needs, market competitiveness and financial sustainability. A builder mindset: you enjoy shaping a hub that is still taking form with a lean team, and you stay close enough to the detail to guarantee quality. The ability to explain complex reward and equity topics simply, and to handle sensitive matters with discretion. Fluent English (our working language). WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2). No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like: - A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously. - Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days. - Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training. At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values. We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications. title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in France. Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology. Accountabilities Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications. Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development. Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation. Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance. Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies. Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs. Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability. Requirements Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable. Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development. Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable. Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures. Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning. Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically. Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings. AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems. Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection. Benefits Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour , with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range. Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement. Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows. Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks. Specialized professional contribution: Use your research, instrumentation, and laboratory expertise in an innovative technology-focused environment. Independent contractor arrangement: Manage your work in a freelance capacity, subject to project requirements and applicable engagement terms. Benefits clarification: This is a contract position. Company-sponsored benefits, including health insurance and paid time off (PTO), are not provided. Contractors are responsible for supplying their own computer and high-speed internet connection. Automation First: Du reduzierst manuelle Eingriffe durch saubere Skripte, Standards und Self-Service-Lösungen für unsere Teams. Stabiler Betrieb: Du stärkst die Zuverlässigkeit unserer Plattform durch besseres Monitoring, mehr Observability und ein strukturiertes Incident-Management. N achhaltige Lösungen: Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund (Root Cause Analysis), um sie dauerhaft zu lösen, anstatt nur Symptome zu behandeln. description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Financial Services: the banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, and wealth managers people trust with their money, their families, and their futures. These institutions win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Their customers increasingly expect to talk, not type, whether they’re checking a balance, disputing a charge, filing a claim, or asking about a loan. Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to institutions reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale. In this role you will: Win net-new logos and drive ElevenAgents deal volume. raw.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Financial Services
raw.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Financial Services: the banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, and wealth managers people trust with their money, their families, and their futures. These institutions win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Their customers increasingly expect to talk, not type, whether they’re checking a balance, disputing a charge, filing a claim, or asking about a loan.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to institutions reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

  • Win net-new logos and drive ElevenAgents deal volume. These are the two metrics that define success in this role

  • Be able to balance a diverse pipeline of large financial institutions who require white glove experience with medium sized regional clients who require speed to close

  • Partner with the Enterprise Sales Lead to turn warm introductions into qualified opportunities and closed deals

  • Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workflows. Our public use cases include account inquiries, payment support, fraud triage, loan origination, claims processing, collections, and compliance verification. Others include caller verification, onboarding, policy servicing and renewals, and contact center coaching

  • Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in AI governance and model risk

  • Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (CX and Contact Center Operations, Digital and Product, Technology, and Risk, Compliance, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across lines of business

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, guide customers through model-risk, security, and architecture review, and set them up to scale in production

  • Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Financial Services positioning, messaging, and references

Requirements

  • At least 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

  • Financial services experience (banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, payments) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily

  • Proven success closing [six- and seven-figure] deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Proven ability to take a warm introduction through discovery, Proof of Value, and procurement to close

  • Experience selling to both technical buyers (product and engineering) and business buyers (CX, operations, digital), and to risk and compliance gatekeepers, translating complex technology into business value

  • Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs

  • Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, including regulated-industry vendor risk, model risk, and data protection reviews, and able to work autonomously as a cross-functional partner

  • Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships with senior executives, and willingness to travel frequently for onsite client visits and conferences

  • High EQ, self-aware, and curious. Low ego and hands-on, comfortable running your own prospecting and deals

  • Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly

  • Passion for voice and conversational AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

title: Banking Accounting Manager
description: <h2>🧡 About Alma</h2> <p>At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place — serving merchants and consumers.</p> <p>Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience — without encouraging bad debt.</p> <p>As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.</p> <p>With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR in 2025, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!</p> <h2>👐 About the team</h2> <p>Alma is a lender. We originate several million consumer receivables a year, carry them for a few weeks, and refinance them off a deliberately light balance sheet through securitization vehicles (Fonds Communs de Titrisation) and our other funding lines. We are regulated as a société de financement and a payment institution.</p> <p>That changes what "accounting" means here. A lender's accounts are not a monthly deliverable produced at the end of a chain: <strong>they are the chain</strong>. Every payment event, every commission, every provision, every sale of receivables to an FCT has to become a journal entry that ties — to the transaction underneath it, to the general ledger above it, and to the prudential statements the regulator reads. At our scale and growth, this is a strategic topic, and one that is as much about data as it is about accounting.</p> <p>Today the chain exists: an internal core banking ledger we built ourselves, feeding NetSuite, feeding regulatory reporting. What it does not have is a single owner who understands it end-to-end, holds it to the standard a regulated lender needs, and evolves it as the business changes (geographies, products, licenses). That is the role we are opening.</p> <p>You will join an Accounting team inside a Finance organization of ~15 people covering Strategic Financing, FP&amp;A, Accounting, Regulatory reporting and Controlling. You will report to the Head of Financing &amp; Accounting, alongside the Financing team and the General Accounting Manager, who oversees corporate cycles, tax, statutory and consolidated accounts.</p> <p>This is a role with unusual ownership for its level: the banking accounting scope is yours from day one, and so is the data chain that produces it.</p> <h2>💼 About the job</h2> <p><strong>Own the accounting of the credit business:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own how the portfolio is represented in the books: origination, revenue recognition on merchant and customer commissions, deferred income, write-offs and recoveries, cost of risk and provisioning on performing and non-performing exposures.</li> <li>Own the accounting of our securitizations: sales of receivables to the FCTs, derecognition, discount and over-collateralisation, residual interests, servicing and management fees, hedging.</li> <li>Own the accounting of our funding: corporate debt, commercial paper, and the new funding instruments we add as the refinancing strategy evolves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own the core banking ledger:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be the functional owner of the engine that turns business events into accounting: which event, which account, which currency, which date, which counterparty.</li> <li>Specify and validate the accounting schemes for every new product, partner and geography, and work with Engineering and Data on the ledger's model, its feed into the ERP, and the fixes when something drifts.</li> <li>Own the audit trail end-to-end — from a single €40 installment to a line in a prudential statement — and make it documented enough to be walked through by someone whose job is to challenge it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reinforce the control framework:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and automate the reconciliations that hold the whole thing together: ledger ↔ general ledger ↔ bank ↔ FCT reporting ↔ prudential statements.</li> <li>Shorten monthly close, incl. turning a manual, end-of-month, spreadsheet-based check into an automated, evidenced, repeatable control.</li> <li>Be Finance's counterpart to Internal Control and Periodic Control on everything accounting-data related.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own regulatory reporting:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the production and the quality of our prudential and statistical reporting — solvency, large exposures, liquidity, and the statistical returns that go with them.</li> <li>Own the reconciliation tables that matter most: prudential statements to accounting balances, regulatory returns to the trial balance, own funds and RWA back to their audit trail.</li> <li>Own the reporting tooling and its data feeds, and work with the Regulatory and Financing teams on the evolutions of the prudential framework and on the treatment of our securitizations.</li> </ul> <h2>🧩 About you</h2> <p><strong>To succeed in this job:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have around 6-7 years of experience, ideally starting in audit of financial services — banks, consumer credit, asset management, securitization — in a Big 4 or a specialised practice, possibly with a first move in-house. You know how to build a number, prove it, and defend it line by line in front of people whose job is to challenge it.</li> <li>You know banking accounting for real: French banking GAAP, the PCEC, cost of risk, revenue recognition on credit products. Or you know financial services accounting well enough that the banking layer is a matter of months, not years.</li> <li>You actually enjoy controls at scale — reconciling large populations, hunting the anomaly, chasing the last twelve euros of a four-hundred-million balance until you know exactly where they went. If that sounds tedious rather than satisfying, this is not your role.</li> <li>You are autonomous and scrappy. On things to build, or on things that already exist.</li> <li>You are fluent in English and French — our documentation and our regulator are French, part of our business and our team are not.</li> </ul> <p><strong>And it will be nice if you also:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold, or are working towards, the DEC (or CPA, ACCA, equivalent).</li> <li>Have been exposed to securitization — FCTs, SPVs, waterfalls, deconsolidation — or to a regulated credit institution from the inside.</li> <li><strong>You are autonomous on data.</strong> SQL is a daily tool, a data warehouse does not intimidate you, and your reflex in front of a five-million-row population is to query it, not to ask someone for a summary. This is the single most important line in this job description.</li> <li>Know NetSuite, BigQuery, dbt or Python.</li> <li>Have worked in a scaling fintech.</li> </ul> <p>Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.</p> <h2>🤑 Compensation &amp; Benefits</h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary based on 12 months</li> <li>Profit-sharing and employee savings plan</li> <li>Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package</li> <li>Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma</li> <li>Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities</li> <li>Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.</li> <li>Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)</li> <li>Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma</li> <li>Mental health: free access to MindDay platform</li> <li>Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)</li> <li>Access to our Learning &amp; Development Platform</li> <li>2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer</li> </ul> <h2>🎯 Interview Process</h2> <ul> <li>Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation &amp; present you the role.</li> <li>Video call with Thibaut Mercier, Head of Financing, Regulatory Capital Optimization &amp; Accounting</li> <li>Business case</li> <li>Video call with Stephanie Combe, CFO</li> </ul> <h2>🌍 Diversity &amp; Inclusion</h2> <p>At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.</p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Lead Fraud & AML Ops
description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Role context Pennylane currently operates around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model with Swan and is applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences. As we prepare to onboard new customers under our own licensed entity from mid-2027, we are building our first line of defence across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud and risk operations. As Transaction Monitoring & Fraud Operations Lead , you will be one of the first operational leaders in this greenfield setup. Reporting to the Head of FinCrime Operations, you will lead first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations across Pennylane’s payment activities within a single team. You will own first-line alert handling and fraud case management, with clear escalation paths to Compliance and Risk. Your mission will be to build and launch Pennylane’s first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations, then scale the team and its workflows as volumes grow—while maintaining strong decision quality, auditability and customer protection. This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project and close collaboration with Product, Compliance and Risk. You will help shape how Pennylane protects the financial activity of French SMEs as it brings more of its regulated operations in-house. Responsibilities Own end-to-end first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for business customers, ensuring that alert triage, investigations, customer outreach and escalations are completed in line with policies set by Compliance and Risk and within agreed SLAs. Translate AML/CFT and fraud policies into operational procedures, decision trees and analyst playbooks, and provide evidence-based recommendations on alert quality and operational bottlenecks. Review complex or high-risk alerts within the first-line mandate, oversee post-onboarding fraud cases and ensure that escalations, customer complaints and law-enforcement requests are handled with complete, auditable records. Implement the QA and reporting framework, monitor operational and risk indicators, and support Compliance during controls testing, audits and regulatory reviews. Recruit, onboard and lead the transaction monitoring and fraud analyst team, combining hands-on support with effective coaching and a culture of rigour, accountability and continuous learning. Establish the team’s performance and capacity framework, covering SLAs, productivity, quality, backlogs, false-positive rates and hiring needs. Partner with Product and Tech to test and improve transaction-monitoring, fraud and back-office workflows, prioritising automation while identifying the controls and decisions that should remain manual. First 6–12 months Deliver approved operating procedures, analyst playbooks and escalation rules before go-live. Establish a capacity and hiring plan based on observed alert volumes and handling times. Validate that alert queues, evidence collection, account measures and second-line handovers work operationally before launch. By go-live, have first-line monitoring operational for new customers, with trained coverage, agreed SLAs, documented QA controls and named escalation owners. What we’re looking for Significant experience in transaction monitoring, fraud or broader financial-crime operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including ownership of operational performance and complex case decisions. Proven experience leading and developing an operational team responsible for alert queues or investigations, combining effective coaching with a hands-on player-coach approach when needed. Strong understanding of first-line alert handling: triage, investigation, typology, escalation, and the difference between a fraud case and an AML case. Good working knowledge of French and European AML/CFT expectations, including ACPR and TRACFIN requirements, and experience translating policy into SOPs, decision trees and analyst guidance. Experience working with Product or Tech on workflow or tooling changes. Sound judgement on what to automate, what to sample and what to escalate. Ability to use operational metrics to manage quality, backlogs and capacity. Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions under pressure and communicate complex cases clearly to operational and compliance stakeholders. Comfort building operations in a greenfield environment where volumes are still uncertain and tooling is evolving. Exposure to ACPR expectations, a licensing programme, a BaaS migration or law-enforcement requests would be an advantage. Languages, presence and location Fluent French and English are mandatory. Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris. Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role. Why join Build first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for a new regulated entity from the ground up. Shape the operating model before launch, rather than inheriting fixed processes and tooling. Take ownership of a critical domain with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer protection and responsible growth. Work closely with Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product and Tech on a strategic company project. Recruitment Process 1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter 2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager 3. Case Study with Laurent and Léa (1h) 4. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min) 🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind) 🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile) 🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés 🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking 🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris 💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE 🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib 💻 Un Mac 🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous. Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: -Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules) -Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant -Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes -Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères. Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable ! Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges. Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires). Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @ pennylane.com ou ----- . Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement ." Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 🇪🇸 Datos personales Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
